role_in_parent: Converts finite-dimensionality of the quotient into the successive non-zero-divisor property demanded by the theorem.
statement_nl: Let k be a field, let d be a nonnegative integer, let w_1,...,w_d be positive integers, and let S = k[x_1,...,x_d] be graded by deg(x_i)=w_i. If g_1,...,g_d are homogeneous elements of S and S/(g_1,...,g_d) is finite-dimensional over k, then for each i the image of g_i in S/(g_1,...,g_{i-1}) is not a zero-divisor. Equivalently, g_1,...,g_d is a homogeneous regular sequence.

domain_restrictions: d is a nonnegative integer (may be 0)
each w_i is a positive integer
S is the polynomial ring k[x_1,...,x_d] with weighted grading where deg(x_i) equals w_i
each g_i is homogeneous with respect to this weighted grading
S modulo (g_1,...,g_d) is finite-dimensional as a k-vector space
statement_semantic_sketch.normalized_claim: Assuming S modulo (g_1,...,g_d) is finite-dimensional over k, then for every index i with 1 <= i <= d, multiplication by the image of g_i is injective in the ring S modulo (g_1,...,g_{i-1}); equivalently, the sequence g_1,...,g_d is a homogeneous regular sequence in the sense that each g_i is a non-zero-divisor modulo the ideal generated by the previous ones.
quantifier_order: Given k a field and d a nonnegative integer and weights w_1,...,w_d positive integers and homogeneous elements g_1,...,g_d in S, assume S modulo (g_1,...,g_d) is finite-dimensional over k
For all i in {1,...,d}: the image of g_i in S modulo (g_1,...,g_{i-1}) is not a zero-divisor

variables.name: k
variables.role: base field for the polynomial ring and vector-space finiteness

variables.name: d
variables.role: length of the sequence and number of variables

variables.name: w_i
variables.role: weights defining the grading on S

variables.domain: polynomial ring k[x_1,...,x_d] with a weighted grading
variables.name: S
variables.role: ambient graded ring in which the homogeneous sequence lives

variables.domain: elements of S that are homogeneous with respect to the given weighted grading (for each i in 1..d)
variables.name: g_i
variables.role: the elements whose images are claimed to be non-zero-divisors in successive quotients

variables.name: i
variables.role: index for the successive quotient where the zero-divisor property is tested

witness_dependencies: the element tested in the i-th step is the image of g_i under the natural map from S to S modulo (g_1,...,g_{i-1}), so it depends on the preceding generators g_1 through g_{i-1}
the notion of 'zero-divisor' at step i is with respect to the quotient ring S modulo (g_1,...,g_{i-1}), which depends on g_1 through g_{i-1}
